source.snippet: I want to understand this more - are you saying 'would pay for itself' if you are offering chatbot commercially? Or using it yourself in lieu of ChatGPT etc..? [re: DeepInfer high-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models]

problem_statement: Teams deploying open-source LLMs commercially need clarity on total cost of ownership vs. hosted API alternatives, but there is no straightforward tool or benchmark that compares self-hosted inference cost (hardware, ops, latency) against pay-per-token API pricing for a given workload.
target_segment: Startup CTOs and ML engineers at companies running chatbots or AI features commercially, evaluating self-hosted vs. API inference spend.
notes: Buyer signal: commenter is explicitly evaluating whether commercial chatbot deployment justifies inference infrastructure cost. Willingness-to-pay implied by 'would pay for itself' framing. Single signal but in a commercial context.
